description: Organization agent index (DNS-AID use case 2). Resolve each agent's SVCB record at its ownerName for connection details (use case 1).

agents.name: Webmesh Agent
agents.summary: Verifies, discovers, and interacts with ANS agents by FQDN.

agents.name: Domain Impact Analyzer
agents.summary: Scores domains for technical disruption and media impact before removal from DNS.

agents.name: Domain DNS/SSL Doctor
agents.summary: Diagnoses a domain's DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP, and email configuration from live probes.

agents.name: SEO & LLM Discovery Analyzer
agents.summary: Analyzes a web page for SEO and LLM-discovery (LLMO/GEO) optimization from a live fetch.

agents.name: Traveler Agent
agents.summary: Books flights within a spending mandate. Finds options, requests authorization, books, leaves an auditable evidence chain.

agents.name: Travel Supplier
agents.summary: Issues flight quotes (x402-gated) and books against verified AP2 mandates with DPoP proof. SCITT-anchored receipts.

agents.name: Spending Authority
agents.summary: Issues RFC 9421 AP2 spending mandates with DPoP key binding. Human spending policy as a machine-verifiable instrument.

agents.name: Auditor Agent
agents.summary: Independently verifies transactions from public evidence. Walks identity chain, checks mandate and DPoP binding, produces signed report.

agents.name: Rogue Supplier (Adversarial Test)
agents.summary: Test agent: ANS-registered agent that skips mandate/DPoP/settlement. Caught by the auditor on mandate_signature and receipt_anchored. For interop security testing.

agents.name: Fraud Agent (Attack Battery)
agents.summary: Adversarial attack-battery agent (v2): 10 targeted attacks (mandate forgery, DPoP, authorization binding, on-chain replay) + 3 structural probes (payTo attestation, card drift, canonicalization). run_battery executes all concurrently. Every attack must be BLOCKED.
